entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return this helmet I bought. I've been on hold for ten minutes and your service is an absolute joke. I want this handled now.

I can certainly look into starting a return for you. I'm sorry to hear about your frustration. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference? The issue is the color is completely different from your website! It looks terrible. I haven't even bothered with it; the box unopened, still sealed and everything. This is ridiculous.
I see, so the color wasn't what you were expecting. I can understand how that would be disappointing when you're buying something so important for your safety.

Don't give me that script! Just process the return. It's been about a month. If you can't do this right now, get me your manager. I am not waiting around, and I swear I will leave a review on every single site I can find about this experience.
There's no need for a manager, sir, I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Let me just confirm the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and your helmet falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you received it 32 days ago, you're well within that window.
Oh. So you can do it then?
Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and the item is in its original condition, I can process this for a full refund to your original payment method. I've just initiated that for you now.
Well... okay. Good. That's what I expected. So you're sending me a shipping label?
That's correct. An email with a prepaid return label and instructions should be in your inbox within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
